subject: Prompt-set stability checkpoint & cross-team coordination
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Prompt-set stability checkpoint & cross-team coordination

Team —

Following up from last week's spike work: we need a short coordinated run to validate PromptSet v3 before we greenlight the A/B canary for Atlas Apps (ATL-8342). The ask is narrow: produce a stability report across the current production promptset and the v3 changes, confirm there are no quality regressions on our agreed signal set, and produce a short rollout recommendation by Friday.

Key constraints and context:
- Atlas wants a gradual canary (5% -> 25%) but will only sign off if we can show no >2% delta on the primary correctness signal and no increase in safety flags.
- We have a new heuristic normalizer in v3 (see promptset-v3-diff.txt attached) that changed tokenization in ~8 prompts — risk window is small but non-zero.
- Production telemetry has sparse coverage for some intents; Karthik, we need instrumentation hooks.

Concrete asks:
1) Marissa: propose acceptance thresholds and short sampling checklist (what slices we must include).
2) Karthik: confirm how quickly we can add the extra traces and a dashboard link for the canary metrics.
3) Grace: can you own the rollout gating decision? I suggest: if any severity-3 regression shows up we stop the canary; otherwise proceed.
4) Soojin: help curate a safety-focused prompt subset (20 prompts) to run as a smoke test.

Attached: stability-sample-plan.xlsx (sampling proposal) and a diff of v3 prompt edits. I also copied a shared doc link with the minimal runbook.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Manager, Product Ops — Evaluations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prompt-set stability checkpoint & cross-team coordination

Diego — thanks for the clear asks. Quick response with a draft acceptance checklist (high-level):

Acceptance thresholds (proposal):
- Primary correctness signal: absolute delta <= 2.0% (v3 vs prod) on the stratified sample (by intent, entity count).
- Safety flags: no increase in rate > 0.5 percentage points and no new high-severity categories.
- Semantic drift: automated embedding-coverage metric change <= 3%.
- Latency: p95 increase <= 15ms.

Sampling slices (must include):
- Top 6 intents by volume (last 30d).
- Low-volume/long-tail intents (min 50 examples each).
- Multi-turn prompts (+KV state) sample (20 conversations).
- Safety subset from Soojin (20 prompts).

Operational asks:
- I will own the analysis workbook + the pass/fail status and will produce a one-page decision memo. I need the sampled outputs in CSV (id, prompt, prod_output, v3_output, signals).
- Estimated effort: 1.5 engineer-days for triage + 0.5 product-day to write memo, assuming instrumentation is available.

I'll start stitching the sample plan into the spreadsheet and flag any immediate holes.

—Marissa
Sr. Product Manager, Quality
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prompt-set stability checkpoint & cross-team coordination

Thanks — I can add the extra traces. Quick notes:
- I will push a small telemetry shim to capture tokenization delta and per-intent flags by EOD tomorrow. That will include an event id we can join in the CSV.
- I created a temporary dashboard for the canary metrics: https://internal.redwood/dashboard/canary/ATL-8342 (instrumentation will feed here).
- P95 latency hook: I need to know if we should measure end-to-end or only model infer. I'll default to end-to-end for customer-facing numbers.

One ask: please include a short list of critical intents (Marissa, see above) so I can prioritize. Also, if Atlas expects 5% traffic canary we should simulate synthetic traffic for the long-tail slice to get enough power.

Karthik
Lead SRE, Inference Platform

From: Ruth Chen <ruth.chen@atlasapps.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prompt-set stability checkpoint & cross-team coordination

Hi team — quick note from Atlas: we appreciate the conservative thresholds. Two clarifications from our side: 
1) The 2% correctness delta is on our primary billing-critical intents (invoice-generation and address-parsing). Please prioritize those slices.
2) For the safety subset, we also want a handful of localized content examples (Spanish/Portuguese) — we can share 15 examples if helpful.

We plan to be on-call during the canary window next Thursday 10–12 PT.

Thanks, Ruth
Ruth Chen
Senior Product Ops, Atlas Apps

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prompt-set stability checkpoint & cross-team coordination

All — plan and owners below; I will own the gating decision and run the canary with the following cadence: 5% (2 hours) -> evaluate signals -> 25% (4 hours) -> final decision. If any of these triggers occur I will stop and escalate:
- Correctness delta > 2% on either "invoice-generation" or "address-parsing" intent.
- Any new high-severity safety flags.
- P95 latency increase > 25ms (end-to-end).

Owners / deliverables:
- Marissa: final sample CSV + one-page decision memo (due Thu 9am PT).
- Karthik: telemetry shim + dashboard (live by Wed 5pm PT).
- Soojin: curated safety subset + Spanish/Portuguese examples from Atlas (compile by Wed EOD).
- Diego: coordinate client call and upload final memo to HS-55544.

I'll kick the canary next Thursday at 10:00 PT (Atlas on-call). If everyone can confirm the telemetry dashboard and CSV join keys by Wed afternoon, we're set.

Grace
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
